title: Duration Parser
description: Takes value: a duration string ('2 days', '1.5h', '-100ms', '1y'; units ms/s/m/h/d/w/mo/y and long forms, case-insensitive, bare numbers are ms) or a number of milliseconds. Returns {valid, operation, milliseconds, short, long} using vercel/ms rules (year = 365.25 days, month = year/12, rounded formatting). Invalid input returns valid:false with error and message.
